Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.

3. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.15 of 2019, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC &
Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Maheshganj, District Pratapgarh.

sentences.text: In terms of the FIR filed on 22.01.2019 it was alleged that daughter of the informant aged about 15 years was missing and was enticed by the applicant.

Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was administered something and thereafter, she was taken earlier to Samspur and thereafter to Chandigarh where wrong was also on her.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., there was variance, however, it was accepted that the two co-accused had taken her to Kunda and thereafter to Chandigarh.
The tentative age of the victim is around 16 years.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the victim stayed with the applicant for a period of more than two days at Kunda and Chandigarh without there being any material to suggest that the applicant had raised any hue and cry during the entire journey coupled with the fact that even before the medical authorities, the victim had stated that she had gone to Chandigarh and stayed with him, a case for bail is made out, particularly, when the applicant is in custody since 23.09.2023 and has no criminal history.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pradeep Saroj be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.8.2024 nishant  Pradeep Saroj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47410631/
